app.sourceTool: Built-in OpenAI ImageGen, transparent image edit
app.generation: Precisely edit the first reference, the original generated MDownloader icon. The second reference is the currently shipped small icon and is a reference only for the flat, dark mint-green color (approximately #31886F), not composition or resolution. Output one transparent square PNG and preserve the first reference's thick symmetric rounded capital M with its small downward triangular point joined seamlessly at the center, and its wide thick U-shaped tray with rounded ends. Make ONLY these layout adjustments to that composition: keep the width and horizontal center of the M exactly the same, stretch the entire M including the connected point vertically by about 7%, and shift the whole M upward so its highest point is about 16–17% from the top of the square (reference was about 21%) and its lowest point is about 67–68% from the top (reference was about 69%). Move the intact tray down by about 2.5% of the square: ends start around 59% from the top, bottom edge around 90%. Keep the tray's exact width (about 93% of the square), thickness, rounded corners and upturned ends. This creates a slightly more visible clear transparent gap from the tip to the tray bed, while the tray arms still visually flank the lower part of the M. Keep the original outer silhouette style, round contours, identical two-part layout and balance. The two parts must be separate, and the triangular point remains attached to M. Use clean opaque flat dark mint #31886F consistent with the small color reference, with clean antialiased edges. Genuine transparent background and negative space. No gradients, shadows, glow, glitter, lettering, checkerboard, strokes outside the mark, or other elements.

processing.baseline: Windows System.Drawing HighQualityBicubic, SourceCopy, HighQuality pixel offset and TileFlipXY. Resamples the full source canvas.

retouch.method: Add [1, 12, 9] to visible RGB channels, clamped to 255, to align mint color with the prior toolbar icon. Preserve alpha and the full canvas.
retouch.alphaComparison: Every decoded alpha value in the baseline and final PNGs matches.

visualReview.description: Compared v6 and v7 at 16, 24, 32, and 48 native pixels on light and dark backgrounds. Confirmed the separate tray and M in the pinned toolbar, the media count badge, and the download manager button in isolated Chrome.

sourceCorrection.description: The requested vertical layout changes are part of the generated v7 original. The low-resolution correction operates on RGB only.
sourceCorrection.measurement: Inclusive bounding boxes [left, top, right, bottom] of the two major connected components at alpha >= 160 on the 1254px square originals.
